data.gender_notes: Matriel is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Matriel is derived from the Hebrew word matar, meaning 'mother'. In Christian tradition, Matriel is a name given to the mother of God, Mary, the mother of Jesus Christ. Matriel symbolizes the ultimate expression of love, sacrifice, and nurturing, as Mary carried and raised the Son of God. The name Matriel carries the meaning “Mother of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Matriel usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the love and sacrifice of a mother and the divine power of motherhood.
data.etymology: Matriel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mother of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Matriel total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: מטריאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מקור השם מאותו שם עברי שמשמעותו: כוח, עוצמה, חוזק, גבר, גברות. השם נוצר כסטייה של שם אנגלי, 'material' (חומרי), ולא קשור למשמעות העברית. עם זאת, כיוון שהשם נלקט משפה אחרת, כבראוי לבחון את הקשר שלו לערכי יהדות ונצרות. השם 'מטריאל' מייצג גבריות, חוזק, ועוצמה, כל היכולים לסייע למי שבחר בו כשם. ראיה ברורה לגבי משמעות השם 'מטריאל' נאסף מהתפיסה המאוחדת של כוח וגבריות.

in_greek.name: Ματιέλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος προέρχεται από την αγγλική λέξη 'material' (υλικό), αλλά έχει μεταφραστεί με σημασία που συνάδει με την ελληνική φιλοσοφία. Η δύναμη, η ενέργεια, το σθένος, η ανδρική και η ανδριά είναι οι χαρακτηριστικές που προσδιορίζουν τον όρο. Η επιλογή του ονόματος 'Ματιέλ' για ένα παιδί χριστιανικό μπορεί να γίνει για να τονίσει την ανδρική σθένος και την ενέργεια, προκειμένου να οδηγήσει την παιδιά να ακολουθήσουν την πορεία της θρησκείας.

in_latin.name: Matriel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen 'Matriel' est derivatum a sermone Anglicano 'material' (substantia), sed habet significationem quae convenit cum philosophia Graeca. Vis, potentia, virtus, fortitudo, virilitas sunt characteristicae quae nominem describunt. Electio nominis 'Matriel' pro infantulo christiano potest fieri ut ostendat virtutem virilitatis et potentiam infantuli, ut infantulus sequatur viam religionis.

in_english.long_meaning: The name Matriel has its roots in the English word 'material', but its meaning aligns with the Christian values of strength, power, and masculinity. As a Christian name, Matriel signifies a strong and courageous individual, capable of leading by example and inspiring others. The name's etymology is interesting, as it combines the Hebrew concept of strength and power with the Latin idea of material substance. This blend of meanings creates a unique and powerful name that is both strong and masculine. In the context of Christian tradition, Matriel represents the qualities of a leader, a warrior, and a protector. It is a name that embodies the values of courage, honor, and loyalty, making it an excellent choice for a Christian baby boy.
